name: selenium-ai-agent

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a URL. This is the primary and preferred navigation tool — starts a local browser automatically, no grid session or setup required. Use grid/session tools only when you need parallel browser sessions.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Navigate back in browser history

tools.name: go_forward
tools.description: Navigate forward in browser history

tools.name: refresh_page
tools.description: Refresh the current page

tools.name: scroll_page
tools.description: Scroll the page in a direction by a pixel amount, or scroll a specific element into view using a CSS selector.

tools.name: capture_page
tools.description: Capture the current page state including all interactive elements. Returns a structured snapshot with element references (e1, e2, etc.) that can be used for interactions.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page, viewport, full page, or specific element. Uses BiDi for full-page and element screenshots when available, falls back to classic API.

tools.name: click_element
tools.description: Click on an element using its reference from the page snapshot

ref.description: Element reference (e.g., e1, e2) from page snapshot

tools.name: hover_element
tools.description: Hover over an element using its reference from the page snapshot

ref.description: Element reference (e.g., e1, e2) from page snapshot

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Select an option from a dropdown/select element by value, text, or index

tools.name: drag_drop
tools.description: Drag and drop from source element to target element

sourceRef.description: Source element reference from page snapshot (e.g. "e5")

targetRef.description: Target element reference from page snapshot (e.g. "e10")

tools.name: teach_selector
tools.description: Teach the system a preferred CSS selector for an element. The selector is saved and used as Phase 0 (highest priority) in future element discovery on this domain.

description.description: Description of the element (e.g., "the NL language link", "the search button")

css.description: The preferred CSS selector for this element

tools.name: input_text
tools.description: Type text into an input field or textarea

ref.description: Element reference (e.g., e1, e2) for input field

text.description: Text to type into the field

tools.name: key_press
tools.description: Press a keyboard key, optionally with modifiers (ctrl, alt, shift, meta)

tools.name: file_upload
tools.description: Upload a file through a file input element

ref.description: File input element reference from page snapshot

tools.name: mouse_move
tools.description: Move mouse to specific coordinates

tools.name: mouse_click
tools.description: Click on an element using mouse with specified button

tools.name: mouse_drag
tools.description: Drag from one element to another

tools.name: tab_list
tools.description: List all open browser tabs

tools.name: tab_select
tools.description: Switch to a specific browser tab by index

tools.name: tab_new
tools.description: Open a new browser tab

tools.name: tab_close
tools.description: Close a specific browser tab

tools.name: verify_element_visible
tools.description: Verify that an element is visible on the page

tools.name: verify_text_visible
tools.description: Verify that specific text is visible on the page

text.description: Text content to verify is visible on the page

tools.name: verify_value
tools.description: Verify that an element has the expected value or text content

tools.name: verify_list_visible
tools.description: Verify that multiple text items are visible on the page

items.description: List of text items that should be visible

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for a condition to be met (element visible, URL contains, etc.)

value.description: Value for condition (element selector or text to match)

tools.name: execute_javascript
tools.description: Execute JavaScript code in the browser context. Use "return" to get a value back.

script.description: JavaScript code to execute in the browser

tools.name: resize_window
tools.description: Resize the browser window to specified dimensions or a device preset (mobile, tablet, desktop, desktop-hd)

tools.name: dialog_handle
tools.description: Handle browser dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt)

action.description: Dialog action: accept, dismiss, or get_text

tools.name: console_logs
tools.description: Get browser console logs or clear console. Uses BiDi event collector when available for cross-browser support, falls back to classic log API.

tools.name: network_monitor
tools.description: Monitor network requests or control network state

tools.name: pdf_generate
tools.description: Generate a PDF from the current page. Uses BiDi printPage for cross-browser support (Chrome, Firefox, Edge), falls back to CDP.

tools.name: close_browser
tools.description: Close the browser and end the session

tools.name: reset_session
tools.description: Reset the browser session (close and restart browser)

tools.name: set_stealth_mode
tools.description: Enable or disable stealth mode for undetected browsing. Hides automation indicators like navigator.webdriver to avoid bot detection. If the browser is already running it will be restarted with the new setting.

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Start recording browser actions to generate test scripts later

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stop recording browser actions. Returns full action log with element locators.

tools.name: recording_status
tools.description: Check if recording is active and show recorded actions

tools.name: clear_recording
tools.description: Clear all recorded browser actions

tools.name: planner_setup_page
tools.description: Initialize the testing environment and navigate to the application for test planning

url.description: URL of the web application to test

feature.description: Name of the feature to create test plan for

tools.name: planner_explore_page
tools.description: Explore a specific page in detail, discovering elements and forms

pageName.description: Name of the page/section being explored

tools.name: planner_save_plan
tools.description: Save the completed test plan to a markdown file

planContent.description: Complete test plan content in markdown format

tools.name: generator_setup_page
tools.description:
Initialize the test generation session and navigate to the application.

When a framework is provided (e.g., from a skill), use it and apply its standard folder conventions. When no framework is specified, ask the user:

1. Which test framework? (selenium-python-pytest, playwright-js, webdriverio-ts, robot-framework, selenium-js-jest, selenium-js-mocha, selenium-java-maven, etc.)
2. Use the default structure for that framework? Defaults: pytest: tests/test_*.py, playwright: tests/*.spec.ts, webdriverio: test/specs/*.spec.ts, robot-framework: tests/*.robot, jest/mocha: test/*.test.js, java-maven: src/test/java/*Test.java
3. If not default, which pattern? (Page Object Model, BDD/Gherkin, Data-driven, Custom)

Pass the chosen framework to all subsequent generator and healer tool calls.

url.description: URL of the web application to test

testPlan.description: Test plan content or path to test plan file

tools.name: generator_read_log
tools.description: Retrieve the log of all actions performed during test generation session

tools.name: generator_write_test
tools.description:
Save generated test code to a file and update the .test-manifest.json.

The manifest records everything the healer needs to run tests later:
- framework, run command, config file, project root, base URL
- list of all generated test files

This means the healer can read the manifest and immediately know how to execute tests
without the LLM having to re-analyze the project each time.

The LLM can provide a custom runCommand, or let the tool suggest one based on the framework.

tools.name: generator_write_seed
tools.description:
Write a seed/bootstrap test (authentication, fixtures, environment setup).

Seed tests are registered in the manifest under seedTests[] and are run before
the main test suite by the healer. Use this for:
- Login/auth flows that save cookies or tokens
- Database seeding scripts
- Environment validation checks

testCode.description: Seed test code (auth helper, fixture setup, etc.)

filename.description: Filename for the seed test file

description.description: What this seed test does (e.g. "Login and save auth cookies")

tools.name: generator_save_spec
tools.description:
Save a structured markdown spec to the specs directory.

Specs capture test requirements in a human-readable format before generating test code.
Saved to <outputDir>/specs/<title-slug>.md

tools.name: generator_read_spec
tools.description: Read a spec file from the specs directory

specFile.description: Path to the spec file to read

tools.name: healer_run_tests
healer_debug_test
tools.description:
Run a single test in debug/verbose mode and return detailed output.

Same as healer_run_tests but returns more output (15KB stdout, 8KB stderr) for deeper analysis.

Supports both explicit mode (command + args) and manifest mode (testPath only).
See healer_run_tests for details on both modes.

tools.name: healer_fix_test
tools.description: Apply a fix to a test file. Creates a .bak backup before overwriting. The LLM provides the corrected code.

testPath.description: Absolute path to the test file to fix

tools.name: browser_generate_locator
tools.description: Generate a robust locator strategy for a specific element

elementDescription.description: Description of the element to find a locator for

tools.name: healer_inspect_page
tools.description:
Inspect the current page and compare expected locators against actual elements.

Use after a test failure to understand UI drift before applying a fix. Reports:
- Found elements (locator still works)
- Missing elements (locator broken, may need update)
- Suggested updated locators based on element discovery

locators.description: Expected locators to validate against the live page

tools.name: analyzer_setup
tools.description: Initialize regression analysis session with product URL and business context

url.description: Base URL of the product to analyze

tools.name: analyzer_import_context
tools.description: Import additional context from local files, inline text, or URLs to enrich the analysis

sourceType.description: Type of source: 'file' (local file), 'text' (inline text), 'url' (web page)

source.description: File path, inline text content, or URL depending on sourceType

tools.name: analyzer_scan_product
tools.description: Explore the product using both process walking (from imported context) and page scanning

tools.name: analyzer_build_risk_profile
tools.description: Build comprehensive risk profile from discovered features and context

tools.name: analyzer_save_profile
tools.description: Save the completed risk profile to a file

tools.name: analyzer_generate_documentation
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive product discovery document with screenshots - serves as input for the Planner agent

tools.name: batch_execute
tools.description: Execute multiple tool steps in a single round trip. Intermediate steps skip snapshots by default; the last step includes a snapshot. Max 20 steps. Cannot call batch_execute recursively.

tool.description: Name of the tool to execute

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the tool

steps.description: Array of tool steps to execute sequentially (max 20)
